transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Karl! I've been traveling for three days to work on the manuscript with you, and I walk in to this?! Where is the chapter draft I sent you? There's ink on Jenny's rug, and I can't even find my own notes under all this! You said you'd have everything ready!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

The ink... well, that was an accident. I had intended to clean it, but was waylaid by yet another revision. Let us retrieve your notes and the draft, and I shall assist you in organizing our materials.

transcript.speaker: antagonist

You know how critical this section is, and I swear, if I find that you've rewritten my carefully constructed arguments for the tenth time without even consulting me, I will... I will... Ugh! Just tell me where to find my notes! Are they under *this* pile of books, or the *other* pile of books that's threatening to collapse the table?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

transcript.speaker: antagonist

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

transcript.speaker: antagonist
